value.rationale: Gradient-only reconstruction of pure cubic harmonics on canonical type-D root orbits has intrinsic meaning independently of scalar sampling. In the 24-cell, all four zonal cubics have zero function values on every root, while their full gradients determine them. The complete exact frame spectrum quantifies derivative-only stability and identifies uniquely optimal dimension d=8 and a sharp dimension-uniform lower bound; neither is an arbitrary finite instance nor a small adjustment to a known scalar frame constant.
